responsibilities_block: Monitor DCS parameters and adjust temperature, pressure, and flow.
Operate pumps and valves and perform process-unit startups and shutdowns.
Inspect pipelines and equipment on schedule and report anomalies.
Record operating data, take measurement samples, and send samples for testing.
Execute startup and shutdown plans and support equipment maintenance.
Implement safety and environmental standards and participate in emergency response.
page.work_context_block: Work rotates between day and night shifts. Begin by reviewing handover records, then watch control-room screens and adjust fluctuations through DCS. At intervals, wear a hard hat and inspect the process area: listen to pumps, check valve status, and feel pipeline temperature. Startups and shutdowns are most intense; every step must follow the plan because one mistake can cause an incident. Records fill page after page, and safety awareness cannot lapse for even one second.
